$comment: Format-blueprint manifest for the Demo Builder gadget. Paired with the sibling server.js/client.js/README.md. bindings is intentionally empty: the manifest parser does not validate binding shapes and the correct gatekeeper adapter string can't be hand-authored, so the CF_DEPLOY binding is wired post-instantiation (Connections → bind this gadget to the Cloudflare deploy gatekeeper).
